note: Between Horizons (I027 Tier 4): Dreams of the Sea - the Captain's lifetime ambitions, a modest journal on the laptop. Read by Dreams (src/core/dreams.gd). All are visible from the start; the Captain chooses which to pursue (up to Dreams.MAX_PURSUED at a time) in any order; each comes true by itself from what really happened (the Captain's Log, the boats owned). Kinds: longest_passage (nm: one passage at least this long), visit_north (lat, count: harbours visited at or north of this latitude), visit_region (regions, count: harbours visited in any of these PortData regions), own_ocean_boat (a yacht fitted for ocean passages, Accommodation), later (needs a system that comes with I028: 'system' names it; shown, never active before then). No money or renown: they are the Captain's own.

dreams.title: A passage of your own
dreams.text: Sail a real passage: a hundred miles or more in one voyage, from one harbour to the next.

dreams.title: The northern coast
dreams.text: Explore a northern coastline: moor in three harbours north of the sixty-second parallel.

dreams.title: Southern waters
dreams.text: Sail to a distant region: moor in a harbour on the Mediterranean.

dreams.title: The Caribbean
dreams.text: Cross to the Caribbean and moor in one of its harbours.

dreams.title: A boat for the oceans
dreams.text: Own a yacht fitted for ocean passages.

dreams.title: An ocean crossing
dreams.text: Complete a remarkable voyage: a thousand miles or more in one passage.

dreams.title: A book of your travels
dreams.text: One day, publish a travel book that people admire.

dreams.title: A known world traveller
dreams.text: One day, be known among sailors as a true world traveller.
